title: Grateful Dead Live at The Sportatorium on 1978-04-07
lineage: PCM > Sony PCM601esd (spdif out) > VX Pocket/Laptop > Nuendo > Waves q10 > WAV 16/44
source: Betty Cantor’s Master SBD Reel > PCM > PCM

ai_review.summary: Soundboard recording with a noticeable Sugaree glitch, but fans still love the 1978 performance overall.
ai_review.review: One reviewer flags a serious glitch at the end of "Sugaree," calling it too bad and suggesting a problem with the tape. Another fan gushes about how great 1978 feels, giving the show a solid four‑star endorsement despite the technical hiccup. The mix is generally soundboard quality, but the isolated error keeps the recording from being fully enjoyable.

ai_rating.rationale: Two reviews give opposing scores (0 and 4). The positive comment praises the era/show, while the negative points out a specific recording flaw; averaging yields a modest rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Glitch on the final "know me" of Sugaree noted as too bad; otherwise the soundboard source is acceptable.
